status: PASS for CAD validity, frozen asset integrity, native canonical dimensions, palette export and visual completeness
scope: Isolated native KiCad export probes and standalone Blender renders. Actual PCB projects and delivered Blender scenes were not edited by this review.

native_preview.result: Both full and above-seat variants display intact housings, covers, actuator heads and terminal geometry. Full variant includes below-seat free-state terminals; alternate preserves its above-seat source subset.

segmented_preview.result: Corrected preview displays complete surface unions.

earlier_preview_failure.cause: Camera near clipping plane was 0.1 m while the camera was approximately 0.097 m from the models.
earlier_preview_failure.correction: Set camera clip_start to 0.0001 m and clip_end to 10 m. No model or source geometry was changed.

installed_fit_limits: The repaired source is manufacturer family CAD with nominal, uncompressed retention bends. No elastic compression or installation deformation was simulated.
The actual imported footprint drill is 1.1938 mm; the current manufacturer drawing recommends 1.30 mm. Native PCB holes were preserved.

Nominal electrical terminal axes differ from actual pad axes by 0.010918 mm. Sampled straight shoulders and narrow solder tips fit the actual drill; free-state retention bends exceed its radius by up to 0.331224 mm.
Source family force/plating options, exact historical mold revision, tolerances, cap socket/grip, full switch travel and complete physical assembly fit remain unqualified.
AP214 face colors are inferred presentation choices; original publisher CAD has one grey appearance.
